title: aechmanthera wallichii var. gossypina
intro: Aechmanthera wallichii var. gossypina, commonly known as the Yellow Butea or Yellow Bixa, is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from fever, pain, and inflammation, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, headaches, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Aechmanthera wallichii var. gossypina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
